name: Classic Counter for Elementor
author: Classic Addons

sections.description:
Classic Counter is a powerful and lightweight Elementor addon that allows you to add stunning counters with customizable captions. Enhance your website’s visual appeal by adding dynamic number increments, stylish animations, and interactive effects without writing a single line of code!

This plugin uses countTo, a jQuery plugin
https://github.com/mhuggins/jquery-countTo

Quick Links

  • Live Demo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor and add the Classic Counter widget to your page.
  4. Configure the settings as per your needs and enjoy the stylish counters!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any theme?

Yes, it is compatible with most WordPress themes that support Elementor.

Can I use this plugin without Elementor?

No, this plugin is designed specifically for Elementor and requires it to function properly.

Are the effects customizable?

Yes, you can change overlay styles, captions, and animations via Elementor’s settings.
